narrative.intro: Peachtree Lumber has recorded $99.6M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. Peachtree Lumber received 1 award in the period, and the average award size is $99.6M. Obligations are concentrated in FY27, with prior fiscal years FY22 through FY26 showing $0 in obligations. The reporting covers FY2027 to date. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. The vendor-level totals are partial because the current fiscal year is still in progress. The transaction pattern shows a single, large award so far in the fiscal year rather than multiple smaller orders. Contractors and agencies evaluating competition or partnership should note the concentration of obligations in a single award and the absence of prior-year obligations in the dataset provided. Procurement officers reviewing Peachtree Lumber will find a simple profile: one federal award in the current fiscal year, $99.6M obligated, and no recorded obligations in the previous five fiscal years.

sections.heading: What does the fiscal-year pattern say about Peachtree Lumber's federal activity?
sections.body: Peachtree Lumber shows federal activity only in FY27 so far. The dataset therefore represents a concentrated uptick rather than steady multi-year buying from the federal government.
